verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Microsoft Authenticator supports passkey sign-in (docs-23) but there is no evidence that passkeys created/stored in Authenticator sync across iOS, Android, Windows, Linux, and browsers independent of Microsoft's own ecosystem; backup evidence (docs-13, docs-19) only covers Microsoft cloud/iCloud backup of the app itself, not cross-platform passkey portability. Community evidence (microsoft-authenticator-comm-6) even suggests Microsoft uses non-standard formats and dark patterns that lock users into its own app rather than enabling open, vendor-neutral sync.
